funFact: Abraham Salm designed this church for Amsterdam’s Mennonite congregation in1904. Its restrained Art Nouveau front combines sandstone detailing, stained glass and a wrought-iron entrance canopy. A small roof turret replaces a full bell tower; the adjacent caretaker’s house belongs to the same building.
